title: Turkish Future Tense (-ecek / -acak)
summary: Expressing actions that will happen in the future.
explanation: Attach '-ecek/-acak' to the verb stem (with buffer 'y' if ending in a vowel), followed by personal suffixes.

example_translations.ex_trfut_1: I will read a book tomorrow.

common_error_explanations.err_trfut_1: Use future tense suffixes '-ecek/-acak' for future actions.
